temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego vehicle rolls forward along a narrow two-lane city street in bright daylight, a red fire engine parked at an angle ahead with red lights flashing. By 0:01 a firefighter in turnout gear steps into view and begins waving the vehicle back. Around 0:02 the ego vehicle starts to slow, acknowledging the directing gesture and the blocked lane. From 0:03 onward the ego vehicle steers toward the right curb, clearing the lane, while a second fire engine can be seen approaching from behind the parked engine. Through 0:05 the ego vehicle continues yielding and nearly comes to a stop at the right edge, path cleared. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
